elements.name: Dataset Discovery and Identification
elements.description: Can a user or system discover and uniquely identify this dataset?

sub_elements.name: Persistent Identifier (DOI, RRID, etc.)
sub_elements.evidence: id: https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5; plus cell-line RRIDs (RRID:CVCL_0419, RRID:CVCL_B5P3) and creator ORCIDs
sub_elements.quality_note: Dataverse DOI as top-level ID, additional versioned DOIs, and RRIDs for cell lines all present and well formed

sub_elements.name: Dataset Title and Description Completeness
sub_elements.evidence: title: Cell Maps for Artificial Intelligence (CM4AI); description spanning ~1500 chars explaining mission, modalities (IF, AP-MS, SEC-MS, CRISPR), MuSIC pipeline, and Nature publication
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear title and comprehensive multi-paragraph description well over 200 chars covering purpose, methods, and outputs

sub_elements.name: Keywords or Tags for Searchability
sub_elements.evidence: keywords: [Cell Maps, AI-Ready Data, Bridge2AI, Functional Genomics, Protein-Protein Interactions, Spatial Proteomics, CRISPR Perturbation, ... RO-Crate, FAIRSCAPE]
sub_elements.quality_note: 24 relevant keywords spanning domain, methods, cell lines, conditions, and standards

sub_elements.name: Dataset Landing Page or Platform URL
sub_elements.evidence: page: https://www.cm4ai.org
sub_elements.quality_note: Official project landing page and data portal provided

sub_elements.name: Associated Project or Program
sub_elements.evidence: keywords include Bridge2AI; funders: NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program (grant 1OT2OD032742-01)
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear association with NIH Bridge2AI Functional Genomics project

elements.name: Dataset Access and Retrieval
elements.description: Can the dataset and its associated resources be located, accessed, and downloaded?

sub_elements.name: Access Mechanism Defined
sub_elements.evidence: distribution_formats describe resolvable ARK/DOI RO-Crates; license_and_use_terms note Data Access Committee oversight and commercial-use negotiation; discouraged_uses note temporary pre-publication embargo
sub_elements.quality_note: Access model is clear: open CC BY-NC-SA reuse via resolvable identifiers with committee-governed distribution and stated embargo constraints

sub_elements.name: Data Use Agreement Required?
sub_elements.evidence: KOLF2.1J 'available for access by non-for-profit organizations via a simple MTA'; commercial use 'requires separate license negotiation'; Data Access Committee (led by Jillian Parker) supervises distribution
sub_elements.quality_note: DUA/MTA requirements and commercial licensing pathway explicitly described

sub_elements.name: Download URL or Platform Link Available
sub_elements.evidence: access_urls include https://doi.org/10.18130/V3/DXWOS5, https://www.ndexbio.org, MassIVE, NCBI SRA, and LibraData/UVA Dataverse
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple direct, resolvable download/platform links per data type

sub_elements.name: File Formats Specified
sub_elements.evidence: RO-Crate packages with JSON-LD (Schema.org, EVI); cell maps as hierarchical DAGs via NDEx/Cytoscape/HiView; RGB IF images; mass spec depositions in MassIVE; sequence data in SRA
sub_elements.quality_note: Container and metadata formats specified per modality, though low-level raw file formats (e.g., specific image/MS file types) are only partly named

sub_elements.name: External Links to Similar or Related Datasets
sub_elements.evidence: external_resources list 13 entries including NDEx, MassIVE, NCBI SRA, FAIRSCAPE, Bridge2AI, CFDE, and related Perturbation Cell Atlas (doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734)
sub_elements.quality_note: Rich set of links to related repositories, resources, and datasets

elements.name: Data Reuse and Interoperability
elements.description: Is sufficient information provided to reuse and integrate the dataset with others?

sub_elements.name: License Terms Allow Reuse
sub_elements.evidence: license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; license_and_use_terms detail attribution, non-commercial, share-alike, and citation requirements
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear, standard license with explicit reuse permissions and conditions

sub_elements.name: Data Formats Are Standardized
sub_elements.evidence: RO-Crate packages, JSON-LD metadata using Schema.org and EVI vocabularies; JSON-Schema mini-data-dictionaries
sub_elements.quality_note: Uses recognized standardized packaging and metadata formats

sub_elements.name: Schema or Ontology Conformance Stated
sub_elements.evidence: cleaning_strategies map data to GO, Reactome, PDB, AlphaFoldDB, Schema.org, EVI Evidence Graph Ontology, NCI Thesaurus, BioAssay Ontology, Cell Ontology, CHEBI, EFO
sub_elements.quality_note: Extensive ontology/standard conformance documented (no dedicated conforms_to field, but content is explicit and meaningful)

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Defined for Linking
sub_elements.evidence: FAIRSCAPE assigns ARK persistent globally unique identifiers; RRIDs for cell lines; ORCIDs for creators; versioned DOIs
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple linking identifiers defined across resources and entities

sub_elements.name: Documentation of Processing Tools for Reproducibility
sub_elements.evidence: MuSIC pipeline, FAIRSCAPE-CLI, node2vec, Human Protein Atlas model, Cytoscape multiscale community detection, IMP version 2.18 via Python Modeling Interface
sub_elements.quality_note: Named tools with specific versions and code frameworks supporting reproducibility

elements.name: Ethical Use and Privacy Safeguards
elements.description: Does the dataset provide clear information about consent, privacy, and ethical oversight?

sub_elements.name: IRB or Ethics Review Documented
sub_elements.evidence: human_subject_research.ethics_review_board: CM4AI Ethics Module (Ravitsky, Belisle-Pipon), Data Access Committee (Parker), Bridge2AI Ethics Working Group; irb_approval: 'Not applicable - de-identified cell lines from commercial sources'
sub_elements.quality_note: Ethics oversight bodies documented with named leads; IRB non-applicability justified by data type

sub_elements.name: Deidentification Method Described
sub_elements.evidence: human_subject_research: 'considered to be de-identified as they cannot be matched, with current knowledge, to a human subject'; both cell lines commercially available, ethically sourced, de-identified
sub_elements.quality_note: De-identification status and rationale described appropriately for a cell-line dataset (no algorithmic method applicable)

sub_elements.name: Identifiers Removed or Masked
sub_elements.evidence: sensitive_elements note donor demographic metadata (age, sex, race) is retained for scientific context; no explicit list of removed/masked identifiers
sub_elements.quality_note: No enumerated list of identifiers removed or masked; the file states what metadata is retained rather than what was stripped

sub_elements.name: Informed Consent Obtained from Participants
sub_elements.evidence: No collection_process.consent field; cell lines described as 'ethically sourced' from ATCC and HipSci but donor consent procedures/type not documented
sub_elements.quality_note: Consent procedures for original donors are not described (only ethical sourcing is asserted)

sub_elements.name: Ethical Sourcing Statement Included
sub_elements.evidence: 'Both cell lines (MDA-MB-468 and KOLF2.1J) are commercially available, ethically sourced, de-identified cell lines'; sampling_strategies reiterate ethically sourced selection
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit ethical sourcing statement present and reinforced across sections

elements.name: Data Composition and Structure
elements.description: Can the dataset's structure, modality, and population be understood from metadata?

sub_elements.name: Cohort or Population Characteristics Described
sub_elements.evidence: instances describe MDA-MB-468 (51-year-old black female, metastatic TNBC, ATCC) and KOLF2.1J (healthy male Northern European donor, HipSci) with treatment/differentiation conditions
sub_elements.quality_note: Cell-line 'population' characteristics, origins, and conditions well described

sub_elements.name: Number of Participants or Samples Reported
sub_elements.evidence: 100 chromatin regulators, 100 metabolic enzymes, 11,739 targeted genes, 563 then 464 proteins in IF releases, 17 genes tagged (34 in process), >1,000 and >700 complexes detected
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific quantitative counts reported across modalities

sub_elements.name: Modalities or Data Types Listed
sub_elements.evidence: IF subcellular microscopy (spatial proteomics), AP-MS and SEC-MS (PPI), single-cell CRISPR perturbation screens, integrated hierarchical cell maps
sub_elements.quality_note: All data modalities explicitly enumerated

sub_elements.name: Conditions or Phenotypes Represented
sub_elements.evidence: subpopulations cover MDA-MB-468 untreated/paclitaxel/vorinostat and KOLF2.1J undifferentiated/neurons/NPCs/cardiomyocytes; disorders: cancer, neuropsychiatric, cardiac
sub_elements.quality_note: Conditions, treatments, and disease phenotypes clearly represented

sub_elements.name: File Dimensions or Sampling Rates Provided
sub_elements.evidence: IF imaging described by channel assignment (DAPI/calreticulin/tubulin/target) and cell maps as 10-layer DAGs, but no array dimensions, image resolutions, file sizes, or sampling rates
sub_elements.quality_note: Structural detail present but quantitative file dimensions/resolutions/sizes are not reported

elements.name: Data Provenance and Version Tracking
elements.description: Can a user determine dataset versions, update history, and provenance?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Version Number Provided
sub_elements.evidence: Alpha v0.5, March 2025 Beta V1.4, June 2025 Beta V2.1, October 2025 Beta releases named
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit version numbers for multiple releases

sub_elements.name: Version History Documented
sub_elements.evidence: updates.update_details enumerate releases with dates and DOIs (V1.4 doi:10.18130/V3/B35XWX, V2.1 doi:10.18130/V3/F3TD5R, October doi:10.18130/V3/K7TGEM)
sub_elements.quality_note: Full versioned release history with associated DOIs

sub_elements.name: Change Descriptions for Each Version
sub_elements.evidence: V1.4 adds perturb-seq in iPSCs, SEC-MS in iPSCs, IF in MDA-MB-468; V2.1 adds RGB IF images, metadata corrections, naming changes, SEC-MS for MDA-MB-468; October adds Perturb-seq and SEC-MS for MDA-MB-468
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific per-version change descriptions provided

sub_elements.name: Update Schedule or Frequency Indicated
sub_elements.evidence: updates.frequency: 'Quarterly updates through November 2026; long-term preservation thereafter'
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear update cadence and maintenance horizon stated

sub_elements.name: Versioned Documentation or External References
sub_elements.evidence: Each release linked to a distinct versioned Dataverse DOI; FAIRSCAPE provenance graphs computed per RO-Crate
sub_elements.quality_note: Version-specific persistent references plus machine-readable provenance

elements.name: Scientific Motivation and Funding Transparency
elements.description: Does the metadata clearly state why the dataset exists and who funded it?

sub_elements.name: Motivation or Rationale for Dataset Creation
sub_elements.evidence: purposes and addressing_gaps articulate the interpretable genotype-phenotype 'black box' problem and the need for ethically-sourced, FAIR, AI-ready cell architecture maps
sub_elements.quality_note: Strong scientific rationale and explicit research gaps addressed

sub_elements.name: Primary Research Objective or Task
sub_elements.evidence: tasks (MuSIC integration, VNN development, cell-line characterization, structure modeling) and intended_uses (AI training, genotype-phenotype mapping, drug response)
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific objectives and downstream ML/research tasks defined

sub_elements.name: Funding Source or Grant Agency Listed
sub_elements.evidence: funders: 'National Institutes of Health Common Fund Bridge2AI Program ... administered by NIH Office of the Director'
sub_elements.quality_note: Funding agency and program clearly identified

sub_elements.name: Award Number or Grant ID Present
sub_elements.evidence: NIH grant 1OT2OD032742-01 (Bridge2AI Functional Genomics) and 5U54HG012513-02 (Bridge2AI Bridge Center); Opportunity Number OTA-21-008
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific award numbers and opportunity number provided

sub_elements.name: Acknowledgement of Platform or Participant Support
sub_elements.evidence: 'Additional funding from the Frederick Thomas Fund of the University of Virginia'; long-term preservation supported by UVA committed institutional funds
sub_elements.quality_note: Additional funding and institutional support acknowledged

elements.name: Technical Transparency (Data Collection and Processing)
elements.description: Can data collection and processing steps be replicated or understood?

sub_elements.name: Collection Setting or Sites Described
sub_elements.evidence: Lundberg Lab at Stanford (spatial proteomics), Krogan Laboratory at UCSF (SEC-MS), Ideker Lab UCSD (lead); maintainers list institutional roles
sub_elements.quality_note: Specific labs and institutions responsible for each modality

sub_elements.name: Data Capture Method or Device Listed
sub_elements.evidence: confocal microscopy, automated pipetting robot for fixation/permeabilization, AP-MS/SEC-MS mass spectrometers, 10x Genomics 3'HT kit for single-cell CRISPR screens
sub_elements.quality_note: Instruments and capture devices specified per modality

sub_elements.name: Preprocessing or Cleaning Steps Documented
sub_elements.evidence: preprocessing_strategies detail node2vec/HPA embedding, contrastive co-embedding, multiscale community detection, GO/Reactome/LLM annotation, imaging and MS QC
sub_elements.quality_note: Detailed, step-by-step preprocessing and cleaning pipeline

sub_elements.name: Open-Source Processing Code Provided
sub_elements.evidence: FAIRSCAPE-CLI and FAIRSCAPE framework (https://fairscape.github.io), Integrative Modeling Platform (http://integrativemodeling.org, IMP v2.18), MuSIC pipeline, Cytoscape
sub_elements.quality_note: Open-source tools and code frameworks with URLs and versions

sub_elements.name: External Standards or References Cited
sub_elements.evidence: Nature (Schaffer, Hu et al., doi:10.1038/s41586-025-08878-3), bioRxiv preprint (doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311), Perturbation Cell Atlas (PMCID: PMC11580897)
sub_elements.quality_note: Peer-reviewed and preprint references cited with DOIs/PMCIDs

elements.name: Dataset Evaluation and Limitations Disclosure
elements.description: Does the metadata communicate known risks, biases, or dataset limitations?

sub_elements.name: Limitations Section Present
sub_elements.evidence: discouraged_uses document interim/beta status, pre-publication embargo, incomplete cross-modality overlap, and computed cell maps not yet released; sensitive_elements note data 'does not represent all biological variants in the population'
sub_elements.quality_note: Limitations are explicitly disclosed (via discouraged_uses and sensitivity notes) even without a dedicated limitations field

sub_elements.name: Sampling Bias or Representativeness Noted
sub_elements.evidence: sampling_strategies: is_representative: false, is_random: false, is_sample: false; 'Does not represent all biological variants seen in the population'
sub_elements.quality_note: Non-representativeness explicitly flagged with structured booleans and prose

sub_elements.name: Quality Control or Validation Steps Mentioned
sub_elements.evidence: preproc QC for imaging (standardized automated protocols, checks before release) and mass spectrometry (QC/validation before public release); JSON-Schema validation of all datasets via FAIRSCAPE-CLI
sub_elements.quality_note: QC and validation procedures documented across modalities

sub_elements.name: Known Risks or Use Constraints Listed
sub_elements.evidence: discouraged_uses: no clinical decision-making without validation, use during incomplete release cautioned, analysis requires domain expertise
sub_elements.quality_note: Explicit discouraged uses and constraints enumerated

sub_elements.name: Conflicts of Interest Declared
sub_elements.evidence: No conflicts_of_interest statement present in the datasheet
sub_elements.quality_note: No COI declaration found

elements.name: Cross-Platform and Community Integration
elements.description: Does the dataset connect to wider data ecosystems, repositories, or standards?

sub_elements.name: Dataset Published on a Recognized Platform
sub_elements.evidence: MassIVE Repository, NCBI BioProject/SRA, NDEx (ndexbio.org), UVA LibraData Dataverse (NIH-approved generalist repository); PRIDE deposition planned
sub_elements.quality_note: Published across multiple recognized community repositories

sub_elements.name: Cross-referenced DOIs or Related Dataset Links
sub_elements.evidence: Nature doi:10.1038/s41586-025-08878-3, bioRxiv doi:10.1101/2024.05.21.589311, related Perturbation Cell Atlas doi:10.1101/2024.11.03.621734, multiple versioned Dataverse DOIs
sub_elements.quality_note: Multiple cross-referenced DOIs to publications and related datasets

sub_elements.name: Community Standards or Schema Reference
sub_elements.evidence: FAIR principles, RO-Crate, Schema.org, EVI Evidence Graph Ontology, GO, Reactome, PDB/AlphaFoldDB
sub_elements.quality_note: Broad adherence to community standards and shared vocabularies

sub_elements.name: Associated Outreach Materials
sub_elements.evidence: FAIRSCAPE Framework documentation/tutorial/installation (fairscape.github.io); CM4AI Skills and Workforce Development module training resources
sub_elements.quality_note: Documentation, tutorials, and workforce training resources referenced

sub_elements.name: Similar Dataset Links or Thematic Grouping
sub_elements.evidence: Bridge2AI program (commonfund.nih.gov/bridge2ai), NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE), related Perturbation Cell Atlas publication
sub_elements.quality_note: Clear thematic grouping within Bridge2AI and CFDE with related dataset links

strengths: Exceptional discovery and identification: top-level Dataverse DOI, versioned release DOIs, cell-line RRIDs, and 24 domain-relevant keywords
Rich provenance and version tracking with dated beta releases, per-version change descriptions, distinct versioned DOIs, and FAIRSCAPE machine-readable provenance graphs
Deep technical transparency: named labs/instruments per modality, detailed preprocessing pipeline (node2vec, contrastive co-embedding, MuSIC, IMP v2.18), and open-source frameworks with URLs
Strong interoperability via RO-Crate/JSON-LD packaging and extensive ontology mapping (GO, Reactome, Schema.org, EVI, Cell Ontology, CHEBI, EFO)
Complete funding transparency with agency, two award numbers, opportunity number, project dates, and additional institutional funding
weaknesses: No informed-consent documentation for original cell-line donors beyond asserting 'ethically sourced'
No enumerated list of identifiers removed or masked (only retained donor demographics are described)
No conflicts-of-interest declaration anywhere in the datasheet
File dimensions, image resolutions, and file sizes/sampling rates are not quantified
Low-level raw file formats (specific image and mass-spec file types) are only partly specified alongside the RO-Crate/JSON-LD containers
recommendations: Add a consent statement describing donor consent status/type for the ATCC and HipSci source cell lines
Enumerate the identifiers removed/masked (or explicitly state none exist because the material is inherently de-identified) rather than only listing retained metadata
Add an explicit conflicts_of_interest declaration for the consortium investigators
Report quantitative file dimensions, image resolutions, and approximate dataset/file sizes per modality
Specify concrete raw file formats (e.g., image and mass-spec file types) in addition to the RO-Crate and JSON-LD packaging
